title: Billboard Latin Music Awards 2026: All the Performers & Presenters, How to Watch & More
summary: Becky G, Ryan Castro, Lupillo Rivera, Santos Bravos, Elvis Crespo, Ha*Ash, Jessi Uribe and many more join the gala set for Oct. 22 in Miami.
contentText:
Billboard and Telemundo have unveiled all of the performers and presenters set for the 2026 Billboard Latin Music Awards.

Elvis Crespo, Erick Brian, Ha*Ash, Jessi Uribe, La Nueva Ola de la Cumbia, Nanpa Básico, Nella, Paola Jara, Pututi & Nesty, Santos Bravos and Tony Dize were previously announced as performers at this year’s awards ceremony.

Furthermore, Ana Mena, Baby Rasta & Gringo, Becky G, Clave Especial, Gilberto Santa Rosa, José Luis Rodríguez, Lali, Los Gemelos, Luis Alfonso, Lupillo Rivera, Mike Bahía, Pancho Uresti and Ryan Castro are set as the evening’s presenters.

This year, Peso Pluma leads the list of finalists with 17 entries, including Artist of the Year; Top Latin Album of the Year for DINASTÍA with Tito Double P; and Regional Mexican Artist of the Year, Solo. The música mexicana star is followed by Tito Double P with 15 mentions, Fuerza Regida with 12, Karol G with nine, Prince Royce with eight, and Bad Bunny with seven. Additionally, Fuerza Regida, Rosalía and Rubén Blades will receive special awards.

Hosted by Carmen Villalobos and Javier Poza, the 2026 Billboard Latin Music Week — which coincides with the 2026 Billboard Latin Music Week taking place Oct. 19 to 21 at the Faena Forum in Miami Beach — will broadcast live on Oct. 22 via Telemundo and Peacock from James L. Knight Center.

See all the information on performers, presenters, and how to watch, below. 

Editor’s Note: If additional performers are announced, this post will be updated.

SPECIAL AWARDS

Cristian Castro will be honored with the Billboard Lifetime Achievement Award for his enduring and exceptional career.

Fuerza Regida will receive the Billboard Vanguard Award in honor of the group’s rapid rise in music. 

Rosalía will receive the Hall of Fame Award in recognition of her global influence. 

Rubén Blades will be honored with the Billboard Icon Award, celebrating his timeless career in Latin music. 

HOW TO WATCH

The 2026 Billboard Latin Music Awards will broadcast live on Oct. 22 via Telemundo and Peacock from James L. Knight Center in Downtown Miami. It will also be available on Universo and the Telemundo app, as well as throughout Latin America and the Caribbean via Telemundo Internacional.
